[Remaining Time: One Year]

In the hidden space of the Void Secret Realm, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on a massive boulder and opened his eyes, glancing at the illusory text in the lower left corner of his vision.

“Time to go back.”

*Lin Yuan thought to himself, after spending six hundred years in the Boundless Void, his time was drawing to a close.*

Unless Lin Yuan expended another third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force, once his time ran out, he would automatically return to the Main World.

...

But—

*In the past twenty years, Lin Yuan had felt the constraints of this Boundless Universe on him.*

*Simply put, the efficiency of comprehending the rules was gradually decreasing.*

*To put it in more straightforward terms, the Boundless Void had been exhausted by Lin Yuan.*

The world, differing in size, contained different fundamental mysteries of rules.

For example, taking the Rule of Time as an exemplar, the Rule of Time in the Main Universe was infinitely more vast compared to the Rule of Time in the Central Earth World or the Spirit Realm that Lin Yuan traversed previously…

Unknown was how many times vaster the former was than the latter.

Thus, the Upper Limit of the Main Universe far surpassed that of the Central Earth World and the Spirit Realm.

This was because creatures in the latter worlds were Innate unable to perceive more complex and mysterious rules.

*Now, the Boundless Void was almost similar in principle to Lin Yuan.*

*To continue cultivating in the Boundless Void, unless fully abandoning the comprehension of rules, was essentially meaningless, nothing more than a waste of time.*

*Moreover, if Lin Yuan could transcend to Level Eleven, Level Twelve,*

*the rule profundities he comprehended would likely surpass the Boundless Void.*

*At that point, if Lin Yuan were to return to the Boundless Void, it would be the Boundless Void trying to leech off Lin Yuan’s rule comprehension.*

“Perhaps eons ago, the realm pioneer who failed to reach the ultimate not solely due to lack of foundation or poor luck, but because of the Boundless Void itself?”

*Lin Yuan speculated in his heart, at least from the current outlook, the Boundless Void had never hosted a Level Twelve ultimate being.*

The sole realm pioneer who attempted to break through to Level Twelve eventually failed, with all traces of their existence thoroughly erased.

“But it makes no difference to me.”

*Lin Yuan appeared calm; if the Boundless Void could no longer aid him in rule comprehension, he would return to the Main Universe to continue his insights.*

*If, someday, the Main Universe could no longer provide rule comprehension, he would use the Myriad Realms Gate to venture into higher-dimensional spaces for insights.*

*For almost all beings, their limits had been predestined by their world, but Lin Yuan was different, bearing no such limit shackles.*

…

“A hundred years of arduous cultivation; although the speed had slowed in the last twenty years, overall, it wasn’t bad at all.”

Lin Yuan grinned.

Throughout the century, Lin Yuan devoted the majority of his energy to rule comprehension, with a small fraction focused on refining his Martial Ancestor Golden Body.

Leveraging the entire resources of the Boundless Void, Lin Yuan had trained the Xuanhuang Physique of his Martial Ancestor Golden Body to the Level Eleven Perfect stage.

The reason for investing so significantly in the Martial Ancestor Golden Body was that Lin Yuan had intended to use it as his permanent physical vessel in the Boundless Void ever since he arrived.

Although the Boundless Void couldn’t offer much aid to Lin Yuan in rule comprehension, cultivation was not solely about rule insights.

If Lin Yuan intended to take a break and not focus on rule insights, the Boundless Void was a decent choice; the Martial Ancestor Golden Body could be directly inhabited upon arrival, saving much time.

After all, refining the Xuanhuang Physique of the Martial Ancestor Golden Body to perfection was done using the resources of the Boundless Void, not costing Lin Yuan anything.

“Origin Clock…” Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and a palm-sized golden clock floated before him.

Upon arriving in this Boundless Void and taking control of the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, Lin Yuan immediately summoned the weapon he had nurtured along his journey to this point.

With six hundred years of constant nurturing and a nonstop supply of abundant resources, the might of the Origin Clock was on par with any Level Eleven secret treasure.

If wielded by Lin Yuan, the power it unleashed was incalculable.

After all, the Origin Clock was birthed by Lin Yuan from nothing, perfectly attuned to him, allowing Lin Yuan to unleash its full power with a mere thought.

Another secret treasure would require a full percentage of force to activate, whereas the Origin Clock required only a fraction.

This was why Lin Yuan planned to shatter the peculiar items he obtained from the Two-dimensional World into Primal Force, to nourish the Origin Clock.

If the Origin Clock could reach Level Twelve, it would assist Lin Yuan more than any ten Level Twelve weapons or dozens of Level Twelve weapons.

A weapon perfectly suited to oneself was exceedingly rare, let alone one as perfectly compatible as the Origin Clock?

…

“Countless rules…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound.

The greatest gain from this voyage was his own spiritual will.

Before arriving, Lin Yuan’s spiritual will was merely in the millions, but now, his spiritual will index had reached over thirty-three million three hundred and thirty.

The rise of spiritual will wasn’t as simple as a mere multiplication, becoming increasingly arduous towards the end.

The threshold for the spiritual will index of a supreme being was eighteen million points; the spiritual will index of Level Eleven Perfect legendary life forms generally exceeded ten million points.

*Could it be that a supreme being’s spiritual will was only 1.8 times stronger than that of those Level Eleven Perfect legendary life forms?*

Besides spiritual will,

the most significant improvement was in rule comprehension for Lin Yuan.
